title: Service card
description: The card every repository keeps at .agent-setup/service.yaml (SPEC-repo-baseline.md). The auditor validates it: owner required and never unknown; criticality mirrors .agent-setup/project.json#criticality, which decides the required level; the operational fields are nullable URLs or repository paths that the profile may require.

owner.description: GitHub login or team accountable for the service; never unknown.

criticality.description: What a failure exposes, as .agent-setup/project.json#criticality declares it (the auditor reads the profile, and doctor warns when the card differs); customers raises the required level to at least Silver, personal-data-or-payments one more level.

runbook.description: URL or repository path of the runbook.

dashboard.description: URL or repository path of the service dashboard.

alerts.description: URL or repository path of the alert definitions.

slo.description: URL or repository path of the service level objectives.

on_call.description: Person, rotation or the word owner.
